Company Description
At ServiceNow, our technology makes the world work for everyone, and our people make it possible. We move fast because the world can’t wait, and we innovate in ways no one else can for our customers and communities. By joining ServiceNow, you are part of an ambitious team of change makers who have a restless curiosity and a drive for ingenuity.

We know that your best work happens when you live your best life and share your unique talents, so we do everything we can to make that possible. We dream big together, supporting each other to make our individual and collective dreams come true. The future is ours, and it starts with you.
With more than 7,700+ customers, we serve approximately 85% of the Fortune 500®, and we're proud to be one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® and World's Most Admired Companies™.
Learn more on Life at Now blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at ServiceNow.
Unsure if you meet all the qualifications of a job description but are deeply excited about the role? We still encourage you to apply! At ServiceNow, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected.

We welcome all candidates, including individuals from non-traditional, varied backgrounds, that might not come from a typical path connected to this role. We believe skills and experience are transferrable, and the desire to dream big makes for great candidates.
Job Description

ServiceNow empowers organizations with AI-driven autonomous workflows to streamline operations and achieve results. We seek an experienced solution sales specialist with business expertise and technical skills to drive growth for our Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.

This quota carrying sales role will partner with enterprise sales teams to identify opportunities, lead strategic discovery, demonstrate solutions, and close complex deals. Your dual expertise—part consultant, part seller—positions you to bridge technical capability and business value in ways that resonate with executive stakeholders.

Build and refine the qualification criteria, account strategy, sales motion, and the pitch.
Build pipeline and generate revenue for Autonomous Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.
Lead executive discovery sessions to uncover challenges and quantify AI value.
Develop account strategies focused on customer transformation.
Deliver impactful demonstrations and handle technical questions.
Establish trusted relationships with executive sponsors and collaborate across teams.
Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and workflow automation trends.
What Makes You Successful
Balance executive presence with technical know-how.
Simplify technology into clear business narratives.
Thrive in ambiguous situations and solve complex problems.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Work well in matrixed environments.

7+ years of enterprise software sales or consulting experience.
Proven success selling complex SaaS, ERP, finance, legal, or AI solutions.
Domain expertise in procurement, financial operations, contract management, or legal tech.
Experience in overlay, matrixed, or specialized sales.
Skilled at leading executive engagements and product demonstrations.
Strong executive communication and organizational skills.
Willingness to travel

Experience selling or working with AI platforms and intelligent automation.
Familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, etc.
Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise architecture.
Active use of AI tools.
MBA or equivalent work experience.

Developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan for Central

Support the regional ServiceNow partner channels to drive an effective customer experience
Articulate customer success strategies to the field in order to streamline and standardize Platform presentations and value proposition
Sales and partner eco-system sales enablement
Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams with limited support from inside sales
Sales process management and opportunity closure

We are a fast-scaling, Series A-backed AI SaaS company operating in the procurement intelligence and supply chain space — helping industrial enterprises across Europe modernize and optimize how they buy. With strong investor backing and a growing customer base in the industrial sector, we are expanding our Go-to-Market team in Munich and looking for a Senior Business Development Representative to help drive pipeline growth across European markets.
This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a motivated sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment and is excited to leverage AI tools to supercharge their prospecting workflows. On-site presence in Munich and fluency in German are required for this role.

Own the full prospecting pipeline end-to-end — identifying, engaging, and converting new leads via phone, email, and social media.
Run discovery conversations and build well-qualified opportunities for the wider sales team.
Execute and continuously iterate on both outbound and inbound lead generation strategies.
Conduct independent market research to identify B2B prospects and tailor outreach for the industrial sector.
Develop and refine persuasive sales materials, call scripts, and communication templates.
Organize and deliver internal training sessions and workshops to share prospecting best practices with teammates.
Identify and experiment with AI/ML tools to accelerate prospecting workflows and optimize team efficiency.
Contribute to a high-velocity, performance-driven sales culture with clear, measurable goals.

5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with a strong track record of building and delivering prospecting pipelines and validating/closing leads.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German (native or near-native level required).
Demonstrated experience owning outbound and inbound lead generation strategies in a B2B SaaS environment.
Experience creating and refining call scripts and templates, and organizing internal sales training or workshops.
Ability to conduct independent market research and develop compelling sales materials and presentations.
Comfort identifying and applying AI tools to accelerate sales processes, with a habit of sharing successful approaches with peers.
Willingness and ability to work on-site in Munich.

Prior exposure to the industrial sector, manufacturing, or procurement-related domains.
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment.
Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML tools applied in a sales context.

Resilience and goal orientation — you're energized by ambitious targets, not intimidated by them.
Strong sense of ownership and a "build from scratch" mentality.
Collaborative mindset and genuine eagerness to elevate the whole team.
Location & Work Arrangement
Location: Munich, Bavaria, Germany
Work arrangement: On-site (Munich office)
Visa sponsorship: Not available — candidates must already have the right to work in Germany

Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR para atuar na prospecção ativa de clientes, com foco em segmentos estratégicos de mercado. Este profissional será responsável por identificar oportunidades de negócio, realizar abordagens consultivas e qualificar leads, contribuindo diretamente para a geração de pipeline comercial.
A atuação será predominantemente em Outbound , com eventual suporte ao atendimento de leads oriundos de ações de Inbound .
Principais responsabilidades
Realizar prospecção ativa de empresas por segmento de mercado, utilizando listas, ferramentas de inteligência comercial e CRM.
Executar cadências de contato por telefone, e-mail, LinkedIn e outros canais de prospecção.
Identificar oportunidades comerciais e realizar a abertura de oportunidades no CRM.
Garantir o correto registro de todas as interações, atividades e informações dos leads na plataforma.
Gerenciar tarefas, agendas, follow-ups e compromissos relacionados à carteira de prospecção.
Transferir oportunidades qualificadas para o Executivo de Vendas (EV), responsável pela condução das etapas seguintes da negociação.
Acompanhar indicadores de produtividade e qualidade relacionados à geração de oportunidades.
Manter a organização e atualização dos dados dos clientes e prospects no CRM.
Requisitos
Experiência prévia em prospecção comercial, SDR, pré-vendas ou desenvolvimento de negócios.
Conhecimento de processos de vendas B2B.
Vivência com ferramentas de CRM (Salesforce será considerado diferencial).
Boa capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
Organização, disciplina e capacidade de gestão de atividades simultâneas.
Perfil analítico para qualificação de oportunidades e priorização de esforços.
Facilidade para trabalhar com metas e indicadores de desempenho.
Diferenciais
Experiência com prospecção outbound.
Conhecimento em metodologias de qualificação de leads.
Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, dados, serviços financeiros ou soluções B2B.
Competências comportamentais
Proatividade.
Resiliência.
Orientação para resultados.
Organização e planejamento.
Indicadores da função
Quantidade de leads trabalhados.
Volume de contatos realizados.
Oportunidades abertas.
Receita potencial gerada (pipeline).
Qualidade dos registros e gestão das atividades no CRM.
Objetivo da posição: gerar oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas por meio de prospecção estratégica, garantindo a correta qualificação dos leads, gestão disciplinada do CRM e geração de pipeline previsível para o negócio.

Strategic Prospecting: Identify and research high-growth organizations—from AI startups to Fortune 500 enterprises—that are struggling with Kubernetes scalability and infrastructure costs.

Pipeline Architecture: Own the top-of-funnel engine, converting inbound interest and outbound leads into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.
Multi-Channel Mastery: Orchestrate a modern sequence of touchpoints across LinkedIn, email, and phone, while engaging authentically in developer-centric spaces.
Market Intelligence: Act as a critical feedback loop for Product and Marketing by capturing the "voice of the prospect" and identifying emerging pain points in the AI and MLOps landscape.
Process Innovation: Partner with Sales Ops to constantly refine our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay) and experiment with new ways to automate the mundane so you can focus on the meaningful.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring

Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or a high-intensity customer-facing role, preferably within the DevOps, Cloud, or SaaS space.
Technical Curiosity: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be "K8s-curious." You are excited to learn the difference between a pod and a virtual cluster so you can speak with authority.

About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

s.h: At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for

Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. s.h: 🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
s.t:
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.
⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics , we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading YOLO models , we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.
Following our $30M Series A round , we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.
We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

This isn't an SDR role. It's an apprenticeship designed to turn you into an elite seller.
We don't hire people to book meetings and disappear. We hire Senior BDR who own markets, build playbooks, and learn to close deals working shoulder-to-shoulder with experienced sellers. You'll own two strategic vertical markets end-to-end — research the territory, identify key accounts, build relationships, generate pipeline, and develop the repeatable motion that makes those verticals ours.
You'll be paired 1:1 with an Enterprise Account Executive who'll teach you how complex sales cycles actually move. This is for people who want to build something, own something, and become exceptional at commercial work.
Reporting to the VP of Sales & Success, this role is based in our London office.

Own your markets
Own vertical markets. You're the CEO of your territory. Research accounts, identify decision-makers, understand buying patterns, and figure out how to reach them. You'll design the motion and run it.
Generate qualified pipeline. Build account lists, run outbound campaigns, attend industry events, and create opportunities where none existed. Success is measured by pipeline generated and deals closed.
Lead on messaging. Develop the narrative that resonates in your verticals. You're building the script, not executing someone else's.
Work deals & build the playbook
Work deals alongside an Enterprise AE. Shadow their calls, see how they navigate complex organizations, and eventually lead discovery, presentations, and parts of the sales process yourself.
Build the playbook. Document what works. Turn your territory knowledge into a repeatable motion that scales.
What success looks like
3 months: Deep understanding of your verticals, consistent outbound motion running, shadowing your paired AE on deals.
6 months: Qualified pipeline generated, leading discovery calls, contributing meaningfully to deals.
9 months: Verticals producing consistent pipeline, leading full discovery independently, closing smaller deals.
12 months: Promotion-ready with proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals.

Commercially sharp. You understand how businesses buy and how deals get done. You can have a commercial conversation with a VP without reading a script.
Relentlessly curious. You want to understand why buyers make decisions and what separates deals that close from deals that stall.
Willing to do the work. Cold calls, personalized outreach, attending events, documenting learnings — this requires discipline and consistency.
Determined to learn to close. You're here to become a great seller by working alongside people who've done it before.
Operate like a founder. You take ownership, make decisions without waiting for permission, and iterate quickly.
Technical enough. You don't need to code, but you need to understand how AI and computer vision solve real business problems.

Prior commercial or sales experience in an SDR/BDR capacity — internships, entrepreneurial ventures, or customer-facing roles count.
Existing knowledge of a specific vertical (manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, security, etc.).
Familiarity with AI, computer vision, or developer tooling.
Experience with outbound tooling — Sales Navigator, Apollo, Outreach, or similar.
🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.
Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.
See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

Fast progression: Senior BDR → Mid-Market Account Executive within 12 months for strong performers. Two of our three current mid-market AEs started in entry-level roles.
On-site collaboration: Work with experienced sellers in our London hub.
Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.
Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.
Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.
Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.
Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.
👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.

We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.
This role is based in our London hub on a hybrid basis.

We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI.
Real ownership. You own two verticals end-to-end. You're measured by whether you win the market.
Apprenticeship model. Work 1:1 with an Enterprise AE closing large, complex deals. Learn by doing.
Product-market fit. YOLO is the most popular computer vision model in the world. Your job is to channel that demand into revenue.

If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.

This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.

Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

Mit Aurelio Amberg – Fine Crafts haben wir zudem einen eigenen Geschäftsbereich für hochwertiges Handwerk und Design aufgebaut.

Das tun Sie bei uns
Bei uns erwartet Sie kein eintöniger Büroalltag: Sie arbeiten selbständig in unterschiedlichen Bereichen, begleiten Aufträge und Projekte für verschiedene Kundensegmente und stehen dabei in direktem Kontakt mit unseren Kunden und Lieferanten. Erfahrung im Innendienst, in der Administration oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

Flair für Zahlen und eine strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
Selbständigkeit, Organisationstalent und Freude an einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag.

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen **Sales Executive (m/w/d)** mit großer Begeisterung für den Vertrieb von IIoT-/SaaS-Plattformen, Big Data Technologien und einem besonderen Verständnis für die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden.
In dieser Position lebst Du für die Kundenakquise und -entwicklung in einem stark wachsenden und spannenden Umfeld. Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit – extern als auch intern – sowie die Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse in Spitzenprojekte umzusetzen, sind dabei der Schlüssel zum Erfolg.
**Was dich erwartet**
· Du wirst Teil unseres Vertriebsteams und bist für Vertrieb und Vorstellung innovativer Telematik und IIoT-Lösungen – bestehend aus Hardware, Sensorik und Software – auf C-Level-Ebene verantwortlich.
· Du baust gemeinsam mit Deinen Teamkollegen eine profitable Kundenpipeline auf und entwickelst neue potenzielle Kunden und Geschäftsfelder gemäß unseren Wachstumszielen.
· Du wirst Kundenbedürfnisse individuell identifizieren und geeignete Lösungsansätze mithilfe der richtigen Produkte/Dienstleistungen platzieren.
· Du generierst und qualifizierst neue Leads und ergreifst die Verkaufschancen.
· Du baust langfristige, vertrauensvolle Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Kunden und Vertriebspartnern auf.
· Du unterstützt unseren Marktaufbau und bei Vertriebsaktivitäten unserer internationaler Partner mit Deinem fundierten Know-How.
· Du wirkst bei der Anpassung der Produktlösung zur Steigerung der Kundenzufriedenheit mit.
· Du berichtest regelmäßig über Deine Vertriebserfolge bei Management und Stakeholdern.
· Du gehst mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch ans Werk.
**Was wir uns von dir wünschen**
· Du brennst für den Vertrieb komplexer Connectivity-Lösungen im Bereich IIoT, Telematik und Sensorik.
· Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwesen, IT oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
· Du hast mind. drei Jahre einschlägige Vertriebserfahrung und fundiertes Wissen im Vertrieb von Telematik und IIOT-Lösungen.
· Du verfügst idealerweise über tiefgreifendes Prozessverständnis in den Branchen Chemie, Schienenverkehr und Intermodal-Logistik.
· Du bezeichnest dich gerne als überzeugungs- und durchsetzungsstark und siehst deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sowie dein ausgeprägtes Präsentationstalent als absolute Stärke.
· Du begeisterst dich für komplexe, technische und prozessorientierte Fragestellungen.
· Du kombinierst dein unternehmerisches Denken mit deiner hohen Affinität zu IT und ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten.
· Du hast eine zielorientierte Hands-on Mentalität, bringst Selbstinitiative mit und handelst eigenverantwortlich.
· Du lebst deine Leidenschaft für digitale Themen, Technologien sowie Trends gerne in international arbeitenden Team aus und löst Herausforderungen mit deinem positiven Mindset.
· Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland oder Schweiz.
**Was wir dir anbieten**
· Mitspracherecht – Entscheidungen sind bei uns prägend und haben Einfluss auf unseren Erfolg. Bei uns hast du etwas zu sagen und kannst viel bewirken.
· Spass bei der Arbeit – wir sind ehrlich und offen zueinander. Wir unterstützen und motivieren uns gegenseitig.
· Weiterentwicklung – Du hast eine gute Idee, wie etwas einfacher oder besser funktionieren könnte? Wir schätzen und fördern neue, kreative Initiativen.
· Darüber hinaus bieten wir eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Festanstellung im Herzen von Schaffhausen (Schweiz).
· Exzellente Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und Parkplatz vor Ort.
· Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeiten des mobilen Arbeitens/Home Office.
· Teil eines innovativen Wachstumsunternehmens mit zukunftsprägenden Produkten.
· Flache Hierarchien und Duz-Kultur in einem respektvollen, humorvollen Team sowie geselligen Unternehmensevents.
· Unser Onboarding macht dich zum Telematik und IIoT Profi.
· Mentoring und individuelle Weiterbildung innerhalb der SAVVY®, IPETRONIK und der INDUS Holding AG.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.
## Your Essentials ##
* US Passport or US Permanent Resident
* MSC Cruises is an E-Verify employe

Our Human Health Division maintains a “patient first, profits later” ideology. The organization is comprised of sales, marketing, market access, digital analytics and commercial professionals who are passionate about their role in bringing our medicines to our customers worldwide.
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland.

This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns.

While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market.

· Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets.

· Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events.

· Ensure tailored account management for your assigned territory by understanding and mapping your customers, identifying Drivers and Barriers, understanding the patient journey and influencers on treatment decisions per account.

· Engage in balanced product sales discussions including scientific data with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) to align the customer and business needs.

· Stay up-to date on the latest product and therapeutic area information by attending internal trainings, conferences and symposia, as well as by self-study.

· Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.

· Organize and co-create educational events for HCP’s including sponsorships in line with strategic priorities and budget constraints.

· Demonstrating highest ethical principles conducting Local law, our company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulations.

· 3-5 years of pharmaceutical or biotech sales experience, ideally in specialty care. Experience in Pulmonary Hypertension, Intestinal Lung Disease or Rare Diseases is a strong plus.

· Degree in Life Sciences, medical/paramedical field or another relevant discipline with healthcare curriculum from an accredited institution. shqa Certification «Certified Pharma Sales Representative» is a strong plus.

· Proven experience in managing an existing product portfolio and successfully launching a new product.

· Strong track record of achieving sales targets and supporting marketing efforts in a complex medical environment.

· Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities, with strong organizational and strategic planning skills.

· Experience collaborating with marketing teams to create and implement marketing materials, campaigns and projects.

· Open to innovation and experimentation.

· Fluent in German and additionally English.

· Valid driver’s license.

· Growth-mindset, strong team-player, results-oriented and proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.

· Adaptable to change, ambiguity and a high level of resilience in the face of challenges.

· Independent, motivated and highly organized.

· Excellent interpersonal skills in communication, persuasion and customer relations.

· Possessing a strong learning mindset.

· Identification of challenges or obstacles and proactively ideate on solutions.

· Data-driven decision-making and mindset.

· Comfortable with commercial experimentation and implementing customer projects.

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:
Customer First : We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.
High Quality : True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.
Essential Design : We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.
Always a Better Deal : Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.
Social & Environmental Responsibility : We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.
Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.
If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

Leverage AI and technology tools to scale prospecting efforts; bring ideas and test new approaches to improve outreach efficiency and conversion rates
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics to effectively position Quince against alternatives

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

About LiveKit
LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.
Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.
This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.
You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.

Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.
Partner tightly with enterprise AEs on account strategy you'll co-own named accounts, align on entry points, and run coordinated multi-threaded plays to break into large organizations
Research target accounts to craft highly personalized, technically credible outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone
Book discovery calls and product demos for enterprise AEs; provide full context so they walk in sharp and prepared
Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion
Surface market intelligence back to the product and GTM teams as you're often the first to hear what buyers care about
Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

1–3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company
Genuine curiosity about technology; you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold an intelligent conversation about why a company might choose a managed WebRTC platform over a self-hosted stack
Strong written communication - you know the difference between an email that gets deleted and one that gets a reply
Experience with sales engagement tools and Salesforce
Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
Comfort working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written and flexibility is required

Background selling to engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML teams
Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communications, or WebRTC concepts
Experience at an open-source company with a PLG motion - you understand what it means when a developer has been building with your product for 6 months before the first sales conversation
Experience using AI tools to accelerate prospecting and personalization at scale
Why LiveKit
Enormous market. Real-time AI is becoming a requirement for nearly every enterprise application. We're the infrastructure layer, and we're well ahead of the field.
Incredible developer traction. Our sales team doesn't cold-call strangers they engage with a community that already loves the product.
Technical credibility. You'll sell something that engineers respect. That matters if you care about representing products you believe in.
Trajectory. This is a ground-floor opportunity on an enterprise sales team at a company with serious investor backing, strong revenue growth, and the reference customers to close big deals.
Our Commitment to You
Competitive comp: Base + uncapped commission + equity. We want SDRs who want to win.
An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

Flexible vacation policy

## Zukünftiger Arbeitgeber ##
Die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors in der Schweiz gehört zu den komplexesten und anspruchsvollsten Transformationsaufgaben unserer Zeit. An der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung, Recht und Technologie reicht es nicht aus, nur Systeme zu installieren es braucht strategische Weitsicht, tiefes Verständnis für föderale Prozesse und exzellente Umsetzungsstärke.
Unser Partner ist eine etablierte Schweizer Beratungsunternehmen, das sich konsequent auf die Digitalisierung und Organisationsentwicklung der öffentlichen Hand spezialisiert hat. Hier arbeiten interdisziplinäre Teams aus Betriebswirtschaft, Recht, Informatik und Naturwissenschaften Seite an Seite.
Für den weiteren strategischen Ausbau der Public-Sector-Practice suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit als Senior Consultant Public Sector & Digital Government, die Verantwortung übernimmt, komplexe Mandate steuert und den Erfolg des Unternehmens aktiv mitgestaltet.

In dieser Schlüsselposition steuern Sie anspruchsvolle Transformationsinitiativen für Kantone, Städte, Gemeinden sowie bundesnahe Betriebe und prägen die digitale Schweiz von morgen:
· Strategie- & Organisationsberatung: Sie beraten Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträger auf Departements- und Amtsleitungsebene bei der Definition digitaler Roadmaps, E-Government-Strategien sowie der Neuausrichtung von Organisations- und Governance-Strukturen.
· End-to-End Projekt- & Programm-Management: Sie übernehmen die Gesamt- oder Teilprojektleitung komplexer Digitalisierungsvorhaben von der Initialisierung und Machbarkeitsstudie über die Business-Analyse bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung (z. B. nach HERMES oder agilen Frameworks).
· Öffentliche Beschaffungen (IVöB/BöB): Sie konzipieren und begleiten strukturierte Ausschreibungsverfahren für IT- und Dienstleistungsprojekte der öffentlichen Hand rechtssicher und praxisnah.
· Prozess- & Change-Architektur: Sie analysieren Kernprozesse der öffentlichen Verwaltung, heben Digitalisierungspotenziale und begleiten die Organisationen mit wirkungsvollem Change Management durch die Transformation.
· Practice-Development & Mentoring: Sie bringen sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung des Beratungsangebots ein, beteiligen sich an der Akquisition von Neumandaten und begleiten jüngere Beraterinnen und Berater als Fach-Coach in ihrer Entwicklung.

## **Conseiller/ère commercial(e) Région Mittelland, Berne et Soleure** ##
*100 % · Bilingue allemand - français · rattaché(e) au responsable des ventes à Eclépens · entrée immédiate ou à convenir*
**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.
Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions : c'est l'une de nos valeurs - et c'est exactement ce que nous attendons de notre développement commercial. Ne pas attendre que le marché vienne à nous - le conquérir activement.
*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.
* Conclure : calculer les prix, établir les offres - même les plus complexes - et remporter la commande.
*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.
* Gérer votre activité à l'aide d'indicateurs clés : rendez-vous qualifiés, taux de conclusion, pipeline. Vous les connaissez, les suivez et en assumez la responsabilité.
*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.
* Vous êtes bilingue allemand - français, ou avez l'allemand comme langue maternelle avec d'excellentes connaissances en français (oral et écrit).
* Les objectifs basés sur les chiffres ne vous font pas peur : vous êtes habitué(e) à travailler avec des KPIs, un CRM et des rapports réguliers - et vous y voyez un outil, pas une contrainte.
* La vente industrielle est votre univers : vous connaissez les longs cycles de décision, les multiples interlocuteurs et les défis techniques - et savez comment tenir la distance du premier contact à la signature du contrat.
* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.
*Ces cinq points sont indispensables. Sans eux, nous ne pourrons malheureusement pas prendre en compte votre candidature.*
Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.
**Vos compétences**
* Vous aimez ouvrir des portes - le premier contact vous stimule plutôt que de vous freiner.
* Résilience et endurance : un refus est pour vous une information, pas un échec - et un cycle de vente de dix-huit mois ne vous effraie pas.
* Orientation résultats : vous vous fixez des objectifs ambitieux et faites spontanément rapport de leur avancement.
* Organisation et suivi rigoureux : rien ne se perd, rien ne reste en suspens.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, tant avec les techniciens qu'avec les acheteurs. Sensibilité aux questions environnementales : vous vendez une solution utile - et vous y croyez.
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.

About Grubhub
At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder , Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.
As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience.

We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City, Chicago and Denver, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.
About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly.

Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required. Please include MONTH/YEAR and HOURS per week for all previous work experience listed on the resume. If there is no indication of time in position, we will credit the minimum.

Für unseren Kunden – ein dynamisches und zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen in Villmergen – suchen wir eine durchsetzungsstarke und proaktive Persönlichkeit für den Verkaufsinnendienst (80–100%).
Ihre Rolle: Dreh- und Angelpunkt im Betrieb
In dieser vielseitigen Drehscheibenfunktion sind Sie das bindende Glied zwischen unseren Kunden, der Arbeitsvorbereitung (AVOR) und der Produktion:
· Auftragsabwicklung & Kundenbetreuung: Selbstständiges Erfassen, Bearbeiten und Überwachen von Kundenaufträgen von der Anfrage bis zur Auslieferung.
· Schnittstellenmanagement: Enger Austausch und Abstimmung mit der AVOR und der Fertigung zur Sicherstellung von Lieferterminen und Kapazitäten.
· Angebotserstellung & Stammdatenpflege: Erstellen von Offerten, Pflegen von Kunden- und Artikelstammdaten im SAP sowie Nachfassaktionen.
· Reklamations- & Anfragenmanagement: Kompetente Beratung der Kundschaft am Telefon und per E-Mail sowie lösungsorientierte Handhabung von Beanstandungen.

· Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundbildung (EFZ) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
· Systemkompetenz: Versierter und verhandlungssicherer Umgang mit SAP (SD/MM von Vorteil) sowie fundierte MS-Office-Kenntnisse.
· Erfahrung: Berufserfahrung im Verkaufsinnendienst; Erfahrung in einem technischen oder industriellen Produktionsumfeld ist von grossem Vorteil.
· Persönlichkeit: Proaktive, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Denk- und Arbeitsweise mit hoher Kommunikationsstärke.
· Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen (z. B. Französisch oder Englisch) sind ein Plus.

· Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselfunktion mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung.
· Ein eingespieltes, kollegiales Team und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld.
· Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und faire Sozialleistungen.
· Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort Villmergen.

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
* The Visual Merchandising Manager is responsible for defining, implementing and continuously elevating the visual merchandising standards across all onboard retail environments of MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* The role ensures that every boutique delivers a premium and consistent guest experience while respecting the identity of each cruise brand and the visual standards of the world's leading luxury and premium brands.
* With a particular focus on Fashion & Accessories, the role also coordinates the visual execution of Watches & Jewelry and Beauty & Duty Free boutiques in close collaboration with brand partners and Category teams.
* Working across HQ functions, onboard retail teams, architects, designers and luxury maisons, the Visual Merchandising Manager transforms commercial strategies into inspiring retail environments that maximize customer engagement and commercial performance.

**Global Visual Merchandising Strategy**
* Develop and continuously evolve the global visual merchandising strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.
* Establish visual standards that reflect the positioning of each cruise brand while maintaining commercial effectiveness.
* Ensure consistency of visual execution across the global fleet.
* Develop seasonal visual merchandising calendars supporting commercial initiatives and product launches.
* Create scalable visual standards adaptable to different ship classes and boutique formats.
**Fashion & Accessories Visual Leadership**
* Lead all visual merchandising activities for Fashion & Accessories boutiques.
* Develop display concepts that enhance product storytelling and elevate the guest shopping experience.
* Optimize product presentation to improve visibility, conversion and average transaction value.
* Ensure collections are presented according to luxury retail best practices while adapting to operational realities onboard.
**Watches, Jewelry & Beauty Coordination**
* Coordinate with luxury watch, jewelry and beauty brands to ensure visual execution complies with brand guidelines.
* Manage the implementation of brand display furniture, point-of-sale materials, animations and seasonal campaigns.
* Coordinate installation of showcases, displays and branded environments during new openings and refurbishments.
* Act as the primary visual merchandising contact for supplier visual teams.
**Retail Experience & Guest Journey**
* Develop immersive retail experiences that encourage product discovery and storytelling.
* Ensure visual merchandising supports the overall guest journey across all retail spaces.
* Collaborate with Marketing to translate campaigns into engaging in-store experiences.
* Promote experiential retail through animations, pop-ups, product launches and seasonal activations.
**Newbuilds & Boutique Development**
* Support retail design for new ships, refurbishments and dry docks.
* Collaborate with architects, designers and Category teams to optimize store layouts and product presentation.
* Recommend fixtures, furniture, lighting, materials and display solutions aligned with luxury retail standards.
* Participate in boutique commissioning and opening preparations.
**Brand Standards & Governance**
* Develop and maintain the Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.
* Conduct regular fleet audits to ensure compliance with visual standards.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through performance analysis and guest feedback.
* Maintain strong relationships with visual merchandising teams from luxury brand partners.
**Cross Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.
* Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal VM material delivery.
* Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.
* Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.
**Leadership**
* Lead and develop the Visual Merchandising function across the organization.
* Inspire a culture of creativity, attention to detail and luxury excellence.
* Coach onboard visual champions and retail teams on visual merchandising best practices.
* Promote innovation while ensuring operational simplicity and executional consistency.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of experience in Visual Merchandising within luxury fashion, premium retail or travel retail.
* Strong experience working with internationally recognized luxury and premium brands.
* Experience developing visual merchandising standards across multiple stores or international markets.
* Experience supporting new store openings and retail concept development.
* Experience in luxury department stores, fashion retail or travel retail is highly desirable.
## Your Essentials ##
* Deep understanding of luxury visual merchandising principles and premium customer experience.
* Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.
* Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.
* Experience collaborating with luxury brands and managing brand visual guidelines.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.
* Creative mindset supported by strong execution capabilities.
* Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels regularly.
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

s.h: We are looking for pet lovers – we are looking for you!
s.t:
This is us
In 2020, VOI, BioMedtrix and KYON have joined forces and form a leading global veterinary orthopedic group Movora \- that complement and strengthen each other. Collectively, we now serve more than 50 markets around the world.
Movora is a global company focused on the advancement of animal health. Rooted in veterinary orthopedics, Movora’s foundation is built on three decades of advancements in animal mobility. The group utilizes legacy expertise to deliver a broad range of innovative products by bringing together key leaders in veterinary medical technology to deliver progressive solutions.
Movora embodies a philosophy of always caring. Anticipating consumer needs and offering reliable solutions, alongside education, provide our customers with value beyond product. We are proudly thinking forward. We prioritize reinvention, individuality, and always making the next leap in innovation.
To strengthen our position in the veterinary orthopedics market and to accelerate the success of our fast\-growing company, we are looking for a
Sales Representative for Northern Germany or DACH region (Southern Germany/Austria/Switzerland)
The sales representative is primarily responsible for developing relationships with key customers and prospects and achieving specified sales goals with the regions Northern Germany or DACH region (Southern Germany / Austria / Switzerland). This involves identifying and closing new business, building relationships with major accounts in the region and advocating their needs internally using all resources available.

· Develop and maintain customer relationships in line with Movora’s strategic goals

· Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the assigned region to grow market share andstrengthen brand loyalty

· Act as the main point of contact for customers, holding regular in\-person and virtual meetings tounderstand their needs and provide tailored solutions

· Collaborate closely with internal teams (Customer Service, R\&D and Operations) to share marketinsights, customer feedback, and support product development

· Achieve regional sales and financial targets, contributing to the overall business objectives

· Manage customer data and records to ensure accurate tracking and reporting
Your skills and professional experience

· At minimum 5\+ years relevant sales experience required; medical/veterinary/orthopedic field preferred butnot required

· Proven Sales/Customer Service and problem\-solving skills

· Customer focused with strong client\-facing and verbal/written presentation \& communication skills as wellas strong phone contact handling ability

· Able to personally provide high level of interactive service to targeted customer base as well as proven relationship building and inside sales experience

· The official language of your region and very good verbal and written communication in English; anyadditional language is a plus

· 60\-80% of travel

· A diverse field of activity in a dynamic emerging company with a refreshing spirit

· Quarterly bonuses aligned with your performance, ranging from solid to outstanding

· Regular congresses – for example in Mallorca – fully covered by the company, where you can expand your knowledge, grow your professional network, and directly benefit from the insights gained

· Flexible working hours: it’s results that , not the clock

· The opportunity to help shaping and implementing solutions and expand your territory

· Enjoy your personal, cutting\-edge tech setup

· Enjoy the benefit of a company car in the premium mid\-size range, available for both business and personal use – and you choose the model!

· Per diem allowances provided to cover meals and daily expenses while traveling for business

· Robust pension, full health coverage, and insurance protection

· Join in our epic summer and events

· Join our wellbeing program, designed with your health and wellbeing in mind

· Get to know even more benefits; after your application! jpidc2296c6jm jit0834jm jiy26jm
